journey.name: spark usd bitkit to bitkit
journey.description: Use two onboarded dev builds (regtest), A and B, with Spark connected. Fund A with the Spark test dollar token first (see the PR's manual test: the token's issuer wallet is not part of the journey environment). The dollar balance on Spark is separate from the Arbitrum USDT wallet.

actions.action: On Home of A, verify a tile (testTag "SparkUsdWallet") shows the token ticker, "Spark" and its dollar balance, next to Savings and Spending, and that the total balance includes it.
Open the tile. Verify the title reads "USDT · Spark", the balance header (testTag "SparkUsdBalance") matches the tile, and the funding payment is listed as Received.
On B, open the tile and tap Receive. Verify a QR (testTag "SparkUsdReceiveQr") holding a Spark invoice (sparkrt1…) and "Network: Spark" below it.
Hand B's invoice to A as a URI (lightning:<invoice>). Verify A opens the dollar send flow on the amount step with its available balance, without a recipient screen.
Enter 10, tap Continue (testTag "SparkUsdReview"), and swipe to pay. Verify the sheet shows Sent USDT, then close it (testTag "SparkUsdDone").
Verify A's balance dropped by exactly 10.00 with a Sent row, and B's balance rose by 10.00 with a Received row, with no fee on either side.

On A, start a send and enter a Lightning invoice or a Spark invoice for sats as the recipient. Verify the recipient is rejected with "Enter a valid address for the selected network." and nothing is sent.
